## 6. 明确不核对、也不在本仓库验证的声明

- Thirteen of the residues in MurJ that Sgls contact are completely conserved across diderms.
  - 原因：Requires a multiple sequence alignment over diderm MurJ orthologues, which is not part of this repository. Note that 13 is a SEQUENCE-conservation count; it is not the same quantity as the geometric convergence count computed here (residues contacting the peptide in all three deposited structures).
  - 原文："Thirteen of the residues in MurJ that Sgls contact are completely conserved across diderms"（Fig. 4f）
- Sgls stall the lipid II transport cycle by trapping MurJ in an outward-facing (periplasm-open) state.
  - 原因：A conformational claim. This repository measures the peptide-bound state only; state selectivity must be tested downstream against an inward-facing structure.

## 8. 复现命令

```bash
python run_evidence.py --out evidence      # 本报告 + 全部表格
python run_pipeline.py --out results       # 设计输出（依赖同一份 priors）
python tests/test_smoke.py                 # 自检
```

修改 `priors/murj_priors.json` 即可替换文献先验（例如换用另一篇论文的突变数据），无需改代码；核对结果会立刻反映在第 5 节。
